comment: Registry of known translation patches and the canonical variant images they produce. Patch files (files/) and built images (out/) are NOT tracked -- same policy as ROMs; this manifest carries the hashes that make every artifact verifiable and reproducible via apply_ips.py --patch-id <id>. Dispatch-profile validity per variant is recorded here (validation.status), NOT in registry/dispatch_state.jsonl, whose L-levels stay scoped to the vanilla ROM.

vanilla-jp11.notes: Final Fantasy IV (Japan) rev 1.1, unheadered LoROM (No-Intro identity); the ROM every dispatch was proven against.

patches.name: J2e Retranslation, 10th Anniversary Edition

validation.profile: 67 dispatch PCs gated (13 real overlaps/callee hits + 54 fail-closed unresolved ranges; see out/j2e-en-v321.impact.json). Review of the >25 alarm (2026-07-15): a dispatch-hit probe over boot+title+intro showed NONE of the 54 fail-closed entries ever fires there and the per-frame hot set (00F535, 15CA5E, 009179, 009F6E, ...) is NOT gated; the 3 gated entries that do fire (boot-time init, genuinely modified by the patch) cost nothing steady-state. Residual watch item: UpdateMode7Regs/UpdateWipe* (world map / transitions) are fail-closed-gated -- measure D6 on device, resolve their ranges manually if cadence suffers.
evidence: 2026-07-15 oracle A/B ON THE PATCHED IMAGE (A = native dispatch + profile, B = pure interpreter), standard baseline excludes (15cadc 048004 03fe03 15ca5e): IDENTICAL on all 4 seeds -- j2e-001-arrival-dialogue (600f), j2e-002-cain-dialogue (600f), j2e-003-baron-freeroam (600f, 14400 native hits), j2e-004-menu-open (300f). Seeds in out/seeds/ (regenerate: headless from reset with --press scripts, see out/seeds regeneration notes in patches/README.md).

2026-07-15 desktop headless smoke: boot to title + scripted intro dialogue, English text rendered by the interpreted text engine, in-game menu fully English (Item/Magic/Equip/Status/Form/Change/Config/Save), no stall. Reproduce: ff4-desktop-headless out/ff4-j2e-v321.sfc --frames 4200 --press start:950 --press a:1100 --press a:1250 --out /tmp/j2e.ppm
validation.gaps: No battle-with-messages or naming-screen seed yet (bank $03 battle code is nearly untouched by the patch -- 30 bytes -- and no battle routine is gated, so exposure is low; the naming screen is not reachable early on the intro rail). Add both when a deeper save exists.
validation.next: device validation (second ROM entry on SD, D6 dialogue/world-map cadence vs vanilla, liveness + screenshot per WF-RELEASE); target status: device-validated

patches.notes: Base-revision ambiguity resolved empirically: applies and plays correctly on rev 1.1. Patch writes into the copier-header region (harmless, stripped). Expands the ROM 1 MiB -> 1.5 MiB; padded to 2 MiB for snes_loadRom's power-of-2 requirement. SRAM/savestate compatibility with vanilla is NOT verified -- treat saves as per-variant.
